name: Peacock
summary: A Share button that crouches, blooms a jewel plume and springs out five feather options
about: Press Share and the button crouches, a soft jewel-coloured plume blooms behind it and five round options spring out along feather-like stems, swaying gently while open. Picking one flies it into the button, which spins while it works and then pops a tick with a burst of feathers and a toast. It suits blogs, recipes, product pages and portfolios.
how: Hover: the arrow lifts. Press Share (click, tap, Enter or Space): the button crouches, then the plume blooms and the options spring out one by one.
Hover or focus an option to see its name; arrow keys move around the fan and Escape folds it.
Pick an option: it squashes and flies into the button while the others fold away.
The button spins while it works (copying the link is real, the others are simulated), then pops a tick with a burst of feathers and a toast.
After a moment the button rolls back to Share. Clicking anywhere else also folds the fan.
